description_en: Modifies the configurations of one or more Mongos or shard nodes in an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 变更云数据库MongoDB分片集群实例中一个或多个Mongos节点、Shard节点的配置
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-node-spec-batch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id dds-bp1337621e8f0000 --nodes-info '{"Shards":[{"DBInstanceClass":"dds.shard.mid","DBInstanceName":"d-bp14ae4572fd0000","Storage":20},{"DBInstanceClass":"dds.shard.mid","DBInstanceName":"d-bp19f4f92dc50000","Storage":30}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNodeSpecBatch

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query available regions
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance whose configurations you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行变更配置的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The specifications of the Mongos or shard nodes to be modified. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要变配的Mongos节点、Shard节点的规格信息。具体规格请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html
parameters.name: nodes_info

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:
true: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has sufficient balance.
<props="china">- false: disables automatic payment. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs in the upper-right corner, choose Orders > My Orders in the left-side navigation pane, and then find the target order on the Orders tab to complete the payment.</props>
<props="intl">- false: disables automatic payment. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs in the upper-right corner, click Order Management in the left-side navigation pane, and then find the target order on the Orders page to complete the payment.</props>

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。取值：
true：自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，选择订购订单>我的订单，在商品订单页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，单击订单管理，在商品订单页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>

默认值为true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The effective period of the configuration change. Valid values:

Immediately: The configuration change takes effect immediately.
MaintainTime: The configuration change takes effect during the maintenance window of the instance.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62008.html operation to modify the maintenance window of the instance.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to view the maintenance window of the instance.

Default value: Immediately
parameters.help_zh:
变更配置的生效时间，取值：

Immediately：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在实例的可维护时间段内生效。

您可以调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62008.html修改实例的可维护时间段。
您可以调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html查看实例可维护时间段时间。

默认为Immediately
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of the configuration change. Valid values:

UPGRADE: upgrades the configurations.
DOWNGRADE: downgrades the configurations.

This parameter is available only when the billing method of the instance is subscription
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值：

UPGRADE：升级配置。
DOWNGRADE：降级配置。

当实例付费方式为包年包月时，该参数可用
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
default or null: uses a coupon. This is the default value.
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination vSwitch when you migrate the instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for cloud disk instances.</notice>

You must specify this parameter only when you migrate the instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配的目标虚拟交换机ID。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone of the hidden node when you migrate the instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for cloud disk instances.</notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetZoneId or TargetSecondaryZoneId parameter.</notice>


You must specify this parameter only when you migrate the instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，隐藏节点（Hidden节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetZoneId和TargetSecondaryZoneId参数值相同。></notice>


只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_hidden_zone_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically align the primary node to the primary zone after operations such as configuration changes for a multi-zone instance. If you choose not to align the node, one primary/secondary switchover (transient connection) is prevented. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 控制多可用区实例在变配等操作后是否自动将 Primary 节点对齐至主可用区。选择不对齐可减少一次主备切换（闪断），默认为 true（对齐）
parameters.name: align_primary_zone

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone of the primary node when you migrate the instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for cloud disk instances.</notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetSecondaryZoneId or TargetHiddenZoneId parameter.</notice>

You must specify this parameter only when you migrate the instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，主节点（Primary节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetSecondaryZoneId和TargetHiddenZoneId参数值相同。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination zone of the secondary node when you migrate the instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for cloud disk instances.</notice>
<notice>The value of this parameter cannot be the same as the value of the TargetZoneId or TargetHiddenZoneId parameter.</notice>

You must specify this parameter only when you migrate the instance across zones and change its configurations at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区同时变配时，从节点（Secondary节点）的目标可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
<notice>该参数取值不能与TargetZoneId和TargetHiddenZoneId参数值相同。></notice>

只有在迁移可用区同时变配才需要传入此参数
parameters.name: target_secondary_zone_id
